open_points.subject: record_change attempt_number assignment
open_points.text: - record_change: [FIELD_ASSIGNMENT] The module alone assigns, inside the transaction: store positions; the random identities trial_execution_id, binding_id, run_id, approval_id and grant_id, drawn from a cryptographically secure source and drawn again on a collision, which is a drawn identity for which the row's load operation finds a row; and every by-field (issued_by, created_by, submitted_by, added_by, activated_by, executed_by, proposed_by, accepted_by, authored_by, started_by, cancelled_by, resumed_by, released_by, decided_by, granted_by, revoked_by, resolved_by) from the actor argument; and each status the field-assignment note of a variant says it writes or sets (proposed, accepted, requested, approved, refused, active, revoked, in_flight and the rest); every other field, times and attempt_number included, comes from the change as given — an attempt_number being the element's next number as the caller read it, the one it spooled under.
open_points.other_text: - record_change: [DETERMINISM_OR_ORDERING] attempt_number of a NodeExecution written by RecordRunProgressChange, RecordReadOutcomeChange, RecordOperationFailureChange or DecideApprovalChange, and of an EffectAttempt written by RecordAttemptInFlightChange, is one more than the number of NodeExecutions the element already has, the length of list_node_execution_rows_by_element for its ElementKey, and RequestApprovalChange gives the EffectApproval it writes that same next number as its attempt_number without writing a NodeExecution; RecordRunProgressChange writes its executions in (node_id, map_index) order with an absent map_index before index 0. A NodeExecution whose files were spooled before it is written carries the attempt_number its caller spooled them under, the element's next number read as the count of its NodeExecutions plus one; the change is refused with RefusedError, writing nothing, when that number is no longer the element's next, and no caller ever chooses another number.
open_points.question: Must attempt_number come from the change as given, or must record_change derive it from the existing NodeExecution count?
